category_findings.identity_and_provenance: Purdue GIS FID 802 names Stewart and gives 800 Northwestern Ave; Stewart Cooperative official home page and Purdue FSCL cooperative list corroborate the facility and address. Named-house official photograph visually ties the modeled visual style to Stewart. No independent parcel overlay was provided.
category_findings.plan_geometry_and_placement: The asset retains the 16-vertex FID 802 ring at wall base. Fresh-open validation reports maximum nearest source-ring vertex residual 0.00002755 m and approximate bounds 13.209 by 23.323 m. This is a by-construction match under the repository approximate local transform, not independent geodetic placement or survey verification; no independent orientation check is supplied.
category_findings.exterior_silhouette_and_openings: The undated, tree-obstructed official image supports pale masonry, dark gabled roofs, a tower-like end mass, tall windows, and an arched glazed entry. The model represents these cues, but its full roof plan/pitch, tower proportions, window rhythm, facade bearing and unseen elevations are estimates; the image does not validate the elevations quantitatively.
category_findings.materials_and_facade: Named procedural materials provide pale masonry, dark gray roofing, glazing, frames/trim and schematic interior surfaces with no external image dependencies. Palette aligns with the official photo, but surfaces are broad color assignments without sourced material texture or calibrated finish values.
category_findings.interior_and_cutaway: Four story/floor groups, stairs, partitions and illustrative furniture/use blocks plus a schematic basement give a legible cutaway and story plan. Official house-tour text supports second- and third-floor hallways and basement context, but no dimensioned/current as-built plan supports room count, circulation, placement or furniture; interiors remain schematic.
category_findings.presentation_and_technical: Blender 5.2.3 LTS fresh-open validation confirms the expected scene, collection and root with 11 meshes and no external image dependency; audit includes exterior, roof, overlay and interior previews. The main root shell has 76 non-manifold edges at architectural openings and is explicitly not watertight; this is documented, not a portability/open failure.

limitations: Exact footprint residual is by construction; no independent parcel-to-footprint overlay, survey control, or verified master placement comparison.
The primary exterior photo is tree-obstructed, lacks a stated capture date and is not a measured elevation.
The GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 field conflicts with official second-/third-floor text; modeled three-story height remains an estimate.
Roof geometry, facade bearing, heights, story dimensions and unseen elevations remain estimated.
Root shell has 76 documented non-manifold edges at open architectural boundaries and is not watertight.
